verses.text: A psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd. I have everything I need.
He has me rest in green pastures and leads me beside quiet waters.
He restores my soul and guides me down the right paths for the sake of his name.
Even when I walk through the valley of death's shadow, I won't fear any evil. You're with me. Your rod and your staff give me comfort.
You set a table for me with my enemies watching. You anoint my head with oil. My cup is overflowing.
Your goodness and faithful love will follow me every day of my life. I'll live in the LORD's house forever. 🙏
